text: The Patriots are navigating a significant injury crisis ahead of Sunday's Week 3 matchup in Jacksonville, with OLB Dre'Mont Jones and rookie OLB Quintayvious Hutchins ruled out, while TE Eli Raridon (thigh) and S Craig Woodson (shoulder) remain questionable despite making the trip—though there's a silver lining as Raridon has returned to practice and CB Carlton Davis III is set to return to the field. To address these roster holes, New England has elevated S Mike Brown and DT Jeremiah Pharms Jr. from the practice squad, while the team will lean heavily on second-round rookie LB Gabe Jacas, who has already made impact plays through the first two weeks and will start against Jacksonville. Beyond the injury report, the Patriots must reckon with their chronic clock-management issues before halftime, having made questionable decisions in back-to-back games late in the second quarter—a discipline problem that could prove costly against a Jaguars team expecting a favorable matchup against a Patriots squad that, by their own admission, are still "finding ourselves."
